zoe: quick ask 1 product wants an 'effective token cost' number on route cards that factors in cache hits + shared prefetch infra. can we prototype?
peter: ok. today we surface raw token cost and separate prefetch ledger. we can emit an amortized_prefetch_credit per-invocation and compute effective_cost = raw_tokens_cost - amortized_prefetch_credit + infra_share.
li: allocation is the tricky bit. options: per-consumer (apportioned by tokens used), per-trigger (credit only triggerer), epoch-amortized (spread evenly over window). product prefers apportioned.
carla: UX: show primary number = effective token cost, subline shows raw cost and savings %. hover expands to breakdown (raw, cache_credit, infra_share, confidence). flag when sample rate < 1%.
zoe: telemetry: add invocation fields: prefetch_id (optional), prefetch_cost_est, sample_weight. analytics job will join prefetch events to invocation uses.
peter: rough SQL prototype:
WITH uses AS (
  SELECT prefetch_id, route, SUM(tokens) AS tokens, SUM(sample_weight) AS w FROM invocation_uses WHERE ts >= :start GROUP BY prefetch_id, route
), totals AS (
  SELECT prefetch_id, SUM(tokens) AS total_tokens FROM uses GROUP BY prefetch_id
)
SELECT u.route, SUM((u.tokens / t.total_tokens) * p.cost_estimate * u.w) / SUM(u.w) AS allocated_prefetch_cost
FROM uses u JOIN totals t USING(prefetch_id) JOIN prefetch_events p USING(prefetch_id) GROUP BY u.route;

li: sampling caveat: we sample ~3% on hot path. use weighted aggregations and compute approx CI. for heavy hitters run bootstrap nightly.
carla: frontend mock will show a small CI whisker and text: "Based on sampled data (3%); click for method details". also a toggle to switch allocation mode for debugging.
deply-bot: nightly-aggregator job succeeded (run=agg-171111-02) :white_check_mark:
zoe: plan: tom implement proto + emit fields behind flag, analytics to run nightly prototype, frontend to add dev-toggle, run 10-day compare apportion vs epoch for top 200 routes. reconvene after results.
li: I'll open PR for sampling-weight-aware aggregators and include fallback when total_tokens==0.
carla: I'll post mock PNG tomorrow. tagging @eng-sre for alerts on route.cache_credit_ratio drops.
zoe: thanks everyone. we'll finalize default after experiment. :rocket:
